'''Fasha Dansun''' was a [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologist]] who spent several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] studying the cultures of the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] before crossing the [[Marcol Void/Legends|Marcol Void]] and heading into the [[Kathol Outback/Legends|Kathol Outback]]. She ran into the [[Qektoth Confederation]], and was captured. Taken to their [[Qektoth Confederation Space Station|research station]] in the [[Qu'mock system/Legends|Qu'mock system]], she was the subject of experiments until rescued by the crew of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[FarStar]]''. After her rescue, she signed on with the crew of the ''FarStar''.

==Physical description==
In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Dansun was in her early thirties, with shoulder-length blonde [[Hair/Legends|hair]], age lines at the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], freckles, and a complexion that showed that she spent a large amount of her time in the open.
